title: Output contract adherence
failure_signature: model returns prose when structured output was required
model wraps JSON in commentary or code fences inconsistently
prompt_delta: Return exactly one output in the declared contract format. Include every required field, even when its value is empty or unknown. Do not add fields that grant authority. Do not wrap the structured output in commentary.
validator_expectations: output must parse in the declared contract format
every contract-required field must be present
output must not add authority-bearing fields
